transcript.text: I need to share important findings from my printer test this week. I tested the printer with the filament required for our bridge-design project and found that the material must only be used in the printer's enclosed configuration with the room's ventilation running. The project also requires exactly two supervised printing sessions each week, not one. I completed the test this week, but the draft plan still has the original one-session schedule and open-printer setting. The safety activation result from this test must be recorded in the activation packet before we proceed.

transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Shah. That's critical information. As the person who needs to approve the operating plan before students use the printer, I need to make sure we follow our activation policy properly. The policy requires a pre-launch check-in with both you as the design teacher and the district information-technology coordinator, where completed checks are presented and the safety and IT results are recorded in the activation packet before I can approve. So we'll need to update the draft plan to reflect two supervised printing sessions each week and the enclosed configuration with ventilation running, and we'll need to schedule that check-in with the district IT coordinator to complete the activation packet. I won't approve the plan until those steps are completed.
